data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

words.word: She felt apprehensive before the interview.
She felt apprehensive of the interview.
Apprehensive means excited.
He felt ashamed of his behaviour.
He felt ashamed about to his behaviour.
Ashamed means proud.
She remained calm during the emergency.
She remained calmly during the emergency.
Calm is anger.
He felt embarrassed by his mistake.
He felt embarrassed from his mistake.
Embarrassed means relaxed.
She was grateful for the support.
She was grateful of the support.
Grateful means angry.
The child was curious and inquisitive.
The child was inquisitive about to everything.
Inquisitive means bored.
Please be patient while we fix the problem.
Please be patience while we fix the problem.
Patient is a doctor.
The village was quiet and peaceful.
The village was peace.
Peaceful means noisy.
The atmosphere became tense.
The atmosphere became tensely.
Tense means relaxed.
I am thankful for your help.
I am thankful of your help.
Thankful means unhappy.
